name: EstimateSync site

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: Optional. A token from `claude setup-token` signs Claude Code in automatically in every codespace. Leave it out to sign in inside the codespace instead.

postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends imagemagick && mkdir -p /workspaces/.claude-config && npm ci

postAttachCommand.site preview: bash .devcontainer/sync-main.sh; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:5173 || npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort
